entities.summary: Risa Wataya is a female Japanese novelist from Kyoto. Her short novel Keritai senaka won the Akutagawa Prize and has sold more than a million copies. Wataya has also won the Bungei Prize and the Kenzaburo Oe Prize. Her work has been translated into German, Italian, French, Thai, Korean, and English. Risa Wataya was a authors & novelists from Kyoto (b. 1984-02-01, Kyoto). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
